summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 22, 2026 news release reporting initial assay results from an 18,000 m relogging and re-assay campaign at the Springer Tungsten Project in Pershing County, Nevada, including intervals such as 7.00 m grading 1.28% WO3 and 24.25 m grading 0.22% WO3. The company also reported stockpile sampling of 499 samples and Bureau of Land Management approval of an Exploration Notice covering five acres of drilling disturbance. This is a routine operational and exploration update, not a special situation; no transaction, shareholder action, board recommendation, advisor or deal terms are disclosed.
